caption:
Lakshman 14 saal ek pal nahi soye… to unki neend kaun so raha tha? 🌙

Vanvaas ki pehli raat Nidra Devi aayin. Lakshman ki neend Urmila ne le li — aur 14 saal soti rahin. Isi wajah se Lakshman Meghnaad ko maar paaye. Agli baar Ram-Lakshman ka naam lein, to Urmila ko bhi yaad rakhiye.

Bada tyaag kiska — Lakshman ya Urmila? Comment mein 'Jai Shri Ram' likhein aur apnon ke saath share karein 🙏

#ramayan #urmila #lakshman #jaishriram #sanatandharma #kaalchitra
title: Lakshman 14 saal kyun nahi soye? Urmila ka tyaag #ramayan #jaishriram
